tagline: A 5-minute quiz that finds the perfume that fits who you are right now.

pitch.text: billions telling you what to buy.

howBody: Answer with what you feel right now — not with your mind, but with your current state, mood, point in life.
howNote: You're welcome to come back when things change. At the end: one main perfume recommendation, and three others at a lower price point. All chosen for who you are — not for which notes you share.
consent: By clicking "Begin", you consent to the collection and analysis of your quiz responses. No personally identifiable information is collected or stored.
